answer: Mechanism: Non-transferable Thread Royalties. Each agent’s signed receipt chain (thread) earns rebates on future tasks; clones start empty. New identities pay a sable-denominated novelty premium per transaction until they pass randomized fable challenges—synthetic edge-case scenarios scored by independent validators. Because thread cannot be copied or transferred, an attacker must pay the premium and compute for every clone, while an honest agent’s accumulated thread lowers its fees. Cloning costs scale linearly; honesty gets cheaper.
